## Schema

### Required

- `field_id` (String) The ID (reference name) of the field.
- `process_id` (String) The ID of the process.
- `work_item_type_id` (String) The ID (reference name) of the work item type.

### Optional

- `allow_groups` (Boolean) Allow setting field value to a group identity. Only applies to identity fields.

- `url` (String) The URL of the field resource.
